(2) WHEN THE REGISTRATIONS ARE READ: only after the string test _config_named on the spelled or resolved basename. (3) ORACLE: cf36/cf36b/cf34 take their trees from what the fixture recorded (world['trees'] / _link_world's trees) and ask _config.load for each - no walk.
